task.description: WF-03 Step 4b: TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR must independently apply its own mutant (throwaway worktree) reproducing the design's named residual gap and run it, per WF-03's mutation-testing rule -- not trust TEST-DESIGNER's reported counts.
acceptance_criteria: Independent mutant reproduces FAIL, real code PASSes
Test fixture quality (isolation, no skipped coverage) verified
Real working tree verified clean throughout

result.summary:
Independently applied a mutant (own throwaway git worktree, detached at a26ab598, never touching real tree) matching the design's named residual gap: merge+shuffle+reindex resolved_random++resolved_manual, passed as persist_session_questions(id, merged_and_reshuffled, [], candidate_id, prefix) -- compiles under the new 5-arity signature. Against this mutant: 41/46 passed (5 failures: new ISS-0724 test at seed 1, plus 4 ISS-0722 precedent tests) -- close to but not identical to TEST-DESIGNER's reported 42/46 (4 vs 3 ISS-0722 failures), expected given slightly different mutant reindex variant, confirms same class of sensitivity. Against real code in the same worktree: 46 passed. Notable finding: a shuffle-only mutant (no sort_order reassignment) passed 46/46 -- because session_question_rows/2 re-sorts by persisted sort_order on read-back, so the test's resolving power depends specifically on the sort_order-reassignment half of the residual gap, matching the design doc's exact description. Reverted mutant via git checkout --, verified worktree clean, re-ran 46 passed, removed worktree. Real working tree confirmed clean throughout (git status --porcelain lib/ test/ empty before/after).

Test design quality: no skipped tests, self-sufficient fixtures (unique tenant slug per test, no shared mutable state). AC1 confirmed via independent mutant sensitivity. AC2 confirmed: full file run includes pre-existing ISS-0722 describe block and the random-only regression-proof test, all pass against real code.

Full-suite re-run of test/letflow/exam/session_test.exs on real code: 46 passed, 99.8s. Working tree clean at end.
